$comment: Night Desk reader themes. The source of truth for the reader's colours and type (web/static/app.css is checked against it by web/themes_test.go) and for other clients such as the iOS app. Colours are sRGB hex. Every text colour meets WCAG 2.2 AA against its background; check new pairs with docs/brand/tools/contrast.py.

roles.bg: App ground: behind the paper, and the app's own bars
roles.muted: Secondary text on the app ground
roles.chip: Buttons and chips on the app ground
roles.p-ink: Headlines and body text on the paper
roles.p-muted: Datelines and metadata on the paper
roles.p-rule: Rules on the paper (non-text, at least 3:1)
roles.p-soft: Quiet fills on the paper (picture placeholders, highlights)
roles.p-accent: Links, labels and focus on the paper

lamplight.name: Lamplight
lamplight.about: Evolve what is there: the ink and cream of the logo, the red rule as the one accent, and the lamp's amber glow as the only warmth. The paper waits in a pool of light.
lamplight.masthead: centred, with the logo's short red rule under the name

broadsheet.name: Broadsheet
broadsheet.about: Bring the reader's newsprint out to the front door: paper grey, near-black ink, proof-red. Built from double rules, columns and the nameplate.

late-edition.name: Late Edition
late-edition.about: The paper lands while the city is still dark: blue-black, slate and cold moonlight around the red rule, a flush-left masthead and a crisper modern serif.
late-edition.masthead: flush left on an accent rail

sepia.$comment: The sepia mode is shared by every theme.
